_comment: Pegged-currency groups. Each array in "groups" is one peg group whose currencies MAY be mixed
on a single QR payment request (e.g. dollar-pegged USD/USDC/USDT). Currencies from two different
groups must not be combined (e.g. USD + BRL); any currency not listed in a group is non-pegged
and must be the only currency on the request. This '_comment' key is documentation only and is
ignored by the loader, keeping the file strict, standard JSON.
